turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. You entered a zero in the gradebook, and I have twenty minutes, so tell me who decided that and why.
"I've heard your points." I asked you a question, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
"Make noise until the facts go away." Then put the facts on the table, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and what was it based on?
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.
That's a serious accusation to make with nothing in your hand. Owen doesn't lie to me, and you've just said it to my face with no document. I'm writing that down, and the principal will read it.
